feeds.title: All Things Sicilian and more
feeds.description: Hello! I am Marisa and welcome to my blog space. It contains various recipes, observations, memories, and information collected over my many visits to Sicily and Italy. Naturally, living in Australia, and traveling to other countries have influenced my cooking. My blog reflects this, therefore the title is All Things Sicilian and More.

feeds.title: Bona Furtuna Blog
feeds.description: Discover recipes and news updates from the Bona Furtuna family in Sicily and blend in with the Italian culture! Bona Furtuna presses the finest estate-grown, 100% organic extra virgin olive oil in the world, exclusively from our farm in Sicily. Over the last seven years, the farms at La Furtuna have grown to over 350 hectares!

feeds.title: Wish Sicily Blog » Food-Related Activities
feeds.description: Discover all our latest news about food and restaurants in Sicily for your next Sicily holidays. Wish Sicily is one of the best 'book-direct-with-owners' websites for holiday villas in Sicily. Our aim is simple, to provide the biggest collection of quality villas in Sicily at the best possible price.

feeds.title: The Pasta Project » Sicily
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jacqui. Find all the authentic pasta recipes, interesting information on Italian culture, tradition, and much more in the blog space. The Pasta Project is a personal undertaking to try every single type of pasta available in the length and breadth of Italy! I love to publish my progress online along with recipes, photos, restaurant reviews, and some historical and geographical information about the different pasta shapes and sauces.

feeds.title: Solo-Dolce » Sicilian Recipes
feeds.description: Hi! I am Anna and welcome to my blog space. Get to read about various Sicilian recipes & cuisines, and live into the moment so as to why they are regarded as one of the true forms of art around the world! Solo-Dolce is a food blog that aims to describe the relationship of love that every single Italian has with the original cuisine. Find almost all the recipes, the most ancient recipe, perhaps brought by the Arabic domination to the most modern recipe due to globalization.

feeds.title: Siciliani Creativi
feeds.description: Siciliani Creativi is your place to find the ultimate guides for Sicilian recipes related to sweets, pasta, and much more. The site Sicilians creative in the kitchen was conceived and managed entirely by Ada Parisi and Gianluca Atzeni, both professional journalists. This Blog page contains infallible recipes, video tutorials, travel itineraries, and insights made in Italy by the blogger Ada.

feeds.title: Sicilian Food Culture
feeds.description: Hi! I am Riccardo. Read about Sicilian recipes, dishes, wine, and much more cuisine-related stuff in the Sicilian Food Culture blog space and get to know about the Sicilian food culture in more detail! The site was created with the intent to increase the popularity of Sicilian Cuisine. You will be able to find recipes for the most famous Sicilian dishes, alongside suggestions on where to find the best ingredients!

feeds.title: Three Farms Island » Words of mouth
feeds.description: It's our Blog, a place where we share info about Sicilian Traditional Agriculture, news about food, and history. News about what we are doing here on our Farm in Sicily. Cook from a Farm in Sicily, where we run our small family organic farms where we farm and organize food experiences in person. Our passion is to farm great food for people who really care about it.

feeds.title: Sicilian Girl
feeds.description: Hi! I am Catherine and welcome to my personal blog space. Read about various Sicilian cuisines, recipes, traditions, and much more. Sicilian Girl is a place where food, family, and faith come together. I post all my views and experiences on the blog so as to share my stories for informational purposes!

feeds.title: La Cambusa Blog
feeds.description: Read the news in our blog, and stay updated on the new menus, new recipes, and events of our restaurant. La Cambusa restaurant was born from the idea of Nonna Oriana who, as a pioneer, opened a Sicilian trattoria in Piazza Marina in 1988. For more than 30 years we have been carrying on the Sicilian culinary tradition enriched and enhanced by many innovations!

feeds.title: Nasuki.guru » Sicilian
feeds.description: Hello! I am Ian and welcome to my blog space. Read all the blogs about various recipes and obtain a fresh view of Italian and especially Sicilian cuisine. Nasuki.guru is the condense and filtering of the material and knowledge that has been obtained over the years and is your ultimate gateway to the Italian and Sicilian kitchen through stories, anecdotes, and personal lived experiences.

feeds.title: A Piece of Sicily Blog
feeds.description: Read all about the recipes, seafood specialties, and much more on Sicilian food in our blog space and get a closer look at the heritage of Sicily! A Piece of Sicily is an online marketplace dedicated to Sicily lovers and Sicily's amazing wealth. Products you find on this site belong to, are sold by, are managed by, and shipped all over the world by Sicilian vendors, who work and operate in Sicily.

feeds.title: The Sicilian Cuisine Blog
feeds.description: Hey there! I am Giorgia and welcome to my blop space. Here you'll find news and stories of dishes, family and traditional recipes, but also information about Sicilian products and ingredients, and comments on what we eat, and sometimes... just fun! This blog was an enlightened idea that was born on January 6th, 2011 (Epiphany day) with the intention to be an open window to the world, about Sicily and Sicilian food and tradition!

feeds.title: Emiko Davies » Sicily
feeds.description: Read about various Sicilian recipes, food history, and much more in the Emiko Davies blog space. Emiko Davies is an award-winning Australian-Japanese food writer, photographer, and cookbook author based in Italy. She has written about regional Italian cuisine and travel for over a decade. She is keen on developing recipes and writes travel guides for well known publications

feeds.title: Food in Sicily
feeds.description: Read about Sicilian dishes, wine, occasional food, and much more in the blog space. Food in Sicily is a company that selects the best agri-food excellence produced in Sicily and offers them at the reach of 'clicks'. The mission is to raise awareness and value of the food and wine and artisan specialties produced in Sicily.

feeds.title: The World of Sicily » Sicilian Recipes
feeds.description: Hello! I am Sergio and welcome to my blog space. Read all the blogs and discover all the Sicilian recipes. The World of Sicily is your complete guide! Find out travel tips on destinations, beaches, traditional Sicilian art, and much more on the site that solely lives up to the beauty and fame of a region like Sicily!
